--- COORDINATOR ---
   1: package com.crypto.execution.processing;
   2: 
   3: import com.crypto.domain.PaperPosition;
   4: import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
   5: import com.crypto.repository.TradeSignalRepository;
   6: import com.crypto.wallet.repository.WalletManagedPositionRepository;
   7: import com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction.InitialPositionLockDeadlock;
   8: import org.slf4j.Logger;
   9: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
  10: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
  11: import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
  12: import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;
  13: import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
  14: import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
  15: import java.time.Instant;
  16: import java.util.Optional;
  17: import java.util.function.Function;
  18: 
  19: /** FIX-127: one coordinator for all Production signal callers. No retry of the
  20:  * existing body after it has begun; only the new initial lock is retry-marked. */
  21: @Service
  22: public class SignalProcessingCoordinator {
  23:     // FIX-125 mandatory in Spring; null only in existing constructor-only policy tests.
  24:     @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
  25:     private com.crypto.wallet.service.WalletTransactionCoordination walletCoordination;
  26: 
  27:     private static final Logger log=LoggerFactory.getLogger(SignalProcessingCoordinator.class);
  28:     private final SignalProcessingStore store;
  29:     private final TradeSignalRepository signals;
  30:     private final WalletManagedPositionRepository positions;
  31:     private final SignalProcessingFreshness freshness;
  32:     private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
  33:     public SignalProcessingCoordinator(SignalProcessingStore store, TradeSignalRepository signals,
  34:             WalletManagedPositionRepository positions, SignalProcessingFreshness freshness, PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
  35:         this.store=store;this.signals=signals;this.positions=positions;this.freshness=freshness;
  36:         transaction=new TransactionTemplate(manager);
  37:         transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
  38:     }
  39:     public Optional<PaperPosition> process(long signalId, boolean background,
  40:             Function<TradeSignal,Optional<PaperPosition>> business) {
  41:         return process(signalId,background,business,null);
  42:     }
  43:     public Optional<PaperPosition> process(long signalId, boolean background,
  44:             Function<TradeSignal,Optional<PaperPosition>> business, Long sourceEventId) {
  45:         if(TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive())
  46:             throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 caller must be outside the processing transaction");
  47:         if(!background && !store.exists(signalId)) {
  48:             // Automatic callers have already registered atomically with creation.
  49:             // Explicit existing-signal calls register only at the user's request.
  50:             transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx->store.register(signals.findById(signalId)
  51:                     .orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Signal not found: "+signalId)),ProcessingOrigin.EXPLICIT));
  52:         }
  53:         store.requireSourceOwner(signalId,sourceEventId);
  54:         for(int localAttempt=0;localAttempt<2;localAttempt++) {
  55:             var work=store.claim(signalId,background);
  56:             if(work==null) {
  57:                 log.info("[FIX-127][NOT_CLAIMED] signalId={}, background={}; no processing performed",signalId,background);
  58:                 return Optional.empty();
  59:             }
  60:             log.info("[FIX-127][ATTEMPT] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, candleOpenTime={}, origin={}, attempt={}, background={}",
  61:                     signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.candleOpenTime(),work.origin(),work.attempts(),background);
  62:             java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger completion=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger(-1);
  63:             try {
  64:                 Optional<PaperPosition> result=transaction.execute(tx->{
  65:                     org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(
  66:                         new org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization() {
  67:                             @Override public void afterCompletion(int status) { completion.set(status); }
  68:                         });
  69:                     // FIX-140: observe the real transaction completion; a thrown exception alone
  70:                     // does not prove rollback. The private marker is only created here.
  71:                     if(walletCoordination!=null) {
  72:                         try { walletCoordination.symbol(work.symbol()); }
  73:                         catch(RuntimeException failure) {
  74:                             if(sourceEventId!=null && retryableSymbolLock(failure))throw new SymbolLockFailure(failure);
  75:                             throw failure;
  76:                         }
  77:                     }
  78:                     var owned=store.locked(signalId);
  79:                     if(owned==null || !"RUNNING".equals(owned.status()) || !work.owner().equals(owned.owner()))
  80:                         throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 processing ownership changed");
  81:                     // Acquire before PositionManagementService inserts a referencing
  82:                     // advisory or executes POSITION_STOP_LOSS. No rules evaluated yet.
  83:                     try {
  84:                         positions.findFirstBySymbolAndStatusOrderByOpenedAtDesc(work.symbol(),"OPEN");
  85:                     } catch(RuntimeException ex) {
  86:                         if(InitialPositionLockDeadlock.isMysqlDeadlock(ex))throw new InitialLockFailure(ex);
  87:                         throw ex;
  88:                     }
  89:                     store.requireSourceOwner(signalId,sourceEventId);
  90:                     // Read signal/freshness after lock acquisition: lock wait must not
  91:                     // consume the recovery grace before it is checked, or establish an
  92:                     // ordinary repeatable-read snapshot before the position is locked.
  93:                     TradeSignal signal=signals.findById(signalId).orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Signal missing"));
  94:                     if(!work.symbol().equals(signal.getSymbol()) || !work.interval().equals(signal.getInterval())
  95:                             || !work.candleOpenTime().equals(signal.getCandleOpenTime()))
  96:                         throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 signal lineage changed");
  97:                     // FIX-153: every claimed attempt, including the first direct
  98:                     // attempt regardless of origin, is checked after normal locks.
  99:                     if(!freshness.eligible(work))throw new Expired();
 100:                     Optional<PaperPosition> outcome=business.apply(signal);
 101:                     store.complete(work,outcome.map(PaperPosition::getId).orElse(null));
 102:                     return outcome;
 103:                 });
 104:                 log.info("[FIX-127][COMPLETED] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, attempt={}; processing committed (not necessarily a trade)",
 105:                         signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.attempts());
 106:                 return result;
 107:             } catch(Expired ex) {
 108:                 // Only exact RUNNING ownership can expire this attempt, after business TX rolled back.
 109:                 if(store.finishWithoutBusiness(work,"EXPIRED","FRESHNESS","Exact candle is no longer latest and fresh")!=1)
 110:                     throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-153 expiry ownership unconfirmed: signal="+signalId);
 111:                 log.warn("[FIX-127][EXPIRED] signalId={}, symbol={}, attempt={}",signalId,work.symbol(),work.attempts());
 112:                 return Optional.empty();
 113:             } catch(RuntimeException ex) {
 114:                 // FIX-140: only this invocation's initial symbol-lock marker plus a
 115:                 // confirmed rollback grants retry. Unknown connection/commit failures stay review-only.
 116:                 if(ex instanceof SymbolLockFailure && completion.get()==
 117:                         org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization.STATUS_ROLLED_BACK) {
 118:                     String result=work.attempts()<4?"SYMBOL_LOCK_RETRY":"LOCK_RETRY_EXHAUSTED";
 119:                     int changed=store.finishSymbolLockFailure(work,result,ex.toString());
 120:                     if(changed!=1)throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-140 retry persistence unconfirmed",ex);
 121:                     log.warn("[FIX-140][SAFE_RETRY_RESULT] event={}, signal={}, attempt={}, outcome={}, rollback=CONFIRMED",
 122:                         sourceEventId,signalId,work.attempts(),result);
 123:                     if("SYMBOL_LOCK_RETRY".equals(result))throw new SymbolLockRetryScheduled(signalId);
 124:                     return Optional.empty();
 125:                 }
 126:                 boolean initial=ex instanceof InitialLockFailure;
 127:                 String status=initial && work.attempts()<2 ? "RETRYABLE_FAILURE" : "REVIEW_REQUIRED";
 128:                 int recorded=store.finishWithoutBusiness(work,status,initial ? "INITIAL_POSITION_LOCK" : "PROCESSING_OR_COMMIT",ex.toString());
 129:                 log.error("[FIX-127][{}] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, attempt={}, initialLock={}",
 130:                         recorded==1 ? status : "FAILURE_RECORD_NOT_UPDATED",signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.attempts(),initial,ex);
 131:                 if(!initial || work.attempts()>=2)throw ex;
 132:                 // TransactionTemplate completed rollback before entering this catch.
 133:             }
 134:         }
 135:         return Optional.empty();
 136:     }
 137:     // FIX-140: classify only known lock cancellation/deadlock errors. Communications
 138:     // errors are deliberately excluded even when nested below a data-access exception.
 139:     static boolean retryableSymbolLock(Throwable failure) {
 140:         for(Throwable e=failure;e!=null;e=e.getCause())
 141:             if(e instanceof java.sql.SQLException sql && sql.getSQLState()!=null && sql.getSQLState().startsWith("08"))return false;
 142:         for(Throwable e=failure;e!=null;e=e.getCause())
 143:             if(e instanceof org.springframework.dao.QueryTimeoutException ||
 144:                e instanceof java.sql.SQLTimeoutException ||
 145:                e instanceof java.sql.SQLException sql && (sql.getErrorCode()==1205 || sql.getErrorCode()==1213))return true;
 146:         return false;
 147:     }
 148:     private static final class SymbolLockFailure extends RuntimeException {
 149:         SymbolLockFailure(Throwable cause) { super(cause); }
 150:     }
 151:     // A private marker cannot be supplied by a later business callback.
 152:     private static final class InitialLockFailure extends RuntimeException {
 153:         InitialLockFailure(RuntimeException cause) { super(cause); }
 154:     }
 155:     private static final class Expired extends RuntimeException {}
 156: }

--- PRICE EVENTS ---
   1: package com.crypto.market.service;

  13: /**
  14:  * FIX-052 exact Replay/Production parity support.
  15:  *
  16:  * Production protects open positions from every canonical 1m Binance live-price
  17:  * update, not only from candle-close analysis signals. Persisting that exact feed
  18:  * lets Replay evaluate TP/SL/profit-lock against the same observations and order.
  19:  * Timestamps are always stored/interpreted as UTC Instants; timezone conversion is
  20:  * a presentation concern only.
  21:  */
  22: @Service
  23: @org.springframework.context.annotation.DependsOn("localTraderInstance")
  24: @RequiredArgsConstructor
  25: public class MarketPriceEventService {
  26:     private static final int PRICE_SCALE=12;
  27:     private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
  28:     @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired(required=false) private com.crypto.local.ExchangeClockSynchronizer exchangeClock;
  29: 
  30:     @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${shared-market.mode:OFF}") private String mode="OFF";
  31:     @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${local-candle.price-max-age-seconds:15}") private long maxAge=15;
  32:     @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${local-candle.price-future-skew-seconds:2}") private long futureSkew=2;
  33:     private static final org.slf4j.Logger log=org.slf4j.LoggerFactory.getLogger(MarketPriceEventService.class);
  34:     private final java.util.Set<Long> inFlight=java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
  35:     public static final String DIRECT_SOURCE="BINANCE_KLINE_DIRECT_FIX153";
  36:     public static BigDecimal normalizePrice(BigDecimal price){
  37:         return price==null?null:price.setScale(PRICE_SCALE,java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  38:     }
  39:     private Instant referenceNow(){Instant local=Instant.now();return exchangeClock==null?local:exchangeClock.correctJvm(local);}
  40:     public String invalidReason(BigDecimal price,Instant observed,Instant now){
  41:         if(price==null || price.signum()<=0)return "INVALID_PRICE";
  42:         if(observed==null)return "MISSING_TIMESTAMP";
  43:         if(observed.isAfter(now.plusSeconds(futureSkew)))return "FUTURE_TIMESTAMP";
  44:         if(observed.isBefore(now.minusSeconds(maxAge)))return "STALE_PRICE";
  45:         return null;
  46:     }
  47:     /** FIX-153: called in INPUT transaction. Invalid observations never occupy slot 1.
  48:      * A duplicate-key error is classified only if the exact canonical key exists; other
  49:      * duplicate constraints/errors propagate. JDBC statement errors do not poison a JPA proxy TX. */
  50:     public Long recordPending(String symbol,BigDecimal price,Instant observed){
  51:         BigDecimal normalizedPrice=normalizePrice(price);
  52:         Instant now=referenceNow();String invalid=invalidReason(normalizedPrice,observed,now);
  53:         if(invalid!=null){
  54:             com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_REJECTED);
  55:             Long ageMs=observed==null?null:java.time.Duration.between(observed,now).toMillis();
  56:             log.info("[FIX-153][PRICE_NOT_CANONICAL] symbol={}, price={}, observedUtc={}, observationAgeMs={}, reason={}",symbol,normalizedPrice,observed,ageMs,invalid);
  57:             return null;
  58:         }
  59:         org.springframework.jdbc.support.GeneratedKeyHolder keys=new org.springframework.jdbc.support.GeneratedKeyHolder();
  60:         try {
  61:             jdbcTemplate.update(connection->{
  62:                 var ps=connection.prepareStatement("INSERT INTO market_price_event(symbol,observed_at,price,source,delivery_status,ordering_slot) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'PENDING',1)",new String[]{"id"});
  63:                 ps.setString(1,symbol);ps.setTimestamp(2,Timestamp.from(observed));ps.setBigDecimal(3,normalizedPrice);ps.setString(4,DIRECT_SOURCE);return ps;
  64:             },keys);
  65:             long id=java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(keys.getKey(),"generated price id").longValue();inFlight.add(id);return id;
  66:         }catch(org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException duplicate){
  67:             var first=jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id,price FROM market_price_event WHERE symbol=? AND observed_at=? AND ordering_slot=1",symbol,Timestamp.from(observed));
  68:             if(first.size()!=1)throw duplicate;
  69:             BigDecimal existing=(BigDecimal)first.getFirst().get("price");
  70:             log.warn("[FIX-153][EQUAL_TIMESTAMP_REJECTED] symbol={}, observedUtc={}, firstEvent={}, firstPrice={}, rejectedPrice={}, observationAgeMs={}, priceDisagreement={}",symbol,observed,first.getFirst().get("id"),existing,normalizedPrice,java.time.Duration.between(observed,now).toMillis(),existing.compareTo(normalizedPrice)!=0);
  71:             jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO market_price_event(symbol,observed_at,price,source,delivery_status,ordering_slot,outcome_reason) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'NON_CANONICAL',NULL,?)",symbol,Timestamp.from(observed),normalizedPrice,DIRECT_SOURCE,existing.compareTo(normalizedPrice)==0?"DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP":"AMBIGUOUS_EQUAL_TIMESTAMP");
  72:             com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_REJECTED);return null;
  73:         }
  74:     }
  75:     public void release(long id){inFlight.remove(id);}
  76:     /** Runs after existing symbol/position lock at READ_COMMITTED, never counts unresolved receipts. */
  77:     public boolean laterApplied(String symbol,Instant observed){
  78:         return !jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id FROM market_price_event WHERE symbol=? AND observed_at>? AND source IN ('BINANCE_KLINE_LIVE_CLOSE',?) AND delivery_status IN ('LEGACY','APPLIED') ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1",symbol,Timestamp.from(observed),DIRECT_SOURCE).isEmpty();
  79:     }
  80:     /** Exact event lineage prevents a caller from completing a different receipt.
  81:      * A lost resolver race rolls back the entire effects transaction. Slot 1 is retained. */
  82:     public void finish(long id,String symbol,Instant observed,BigDecimal price,String state,String reason){
  83:         price=normalizePrice(price);
  84:         if(!org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive())
  85:             throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-153 price outcome requires effects transaction");
  86:         if(!java.util.Set.of("APPLIED","NON_CANONICAL").contains(state))throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIX-153 invalid effects outcome");
  87:         int n=jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE market_price_event SET delivery_status=?,outcome_reason=? WHERE id=? AND source=? AND symbol=? AND observed_at=? AND price=? AND ordering_slot=1 AND delivery_status='PENDING'",state,reason,id,DIRECT_SOURCE,symbol,Timestamp.from(observed),price);
  88:         if(n!=1)throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-153 price outcome ownership/lineage changed: event="+id);
  89:         org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization(){
  90:             @Override public void afterCompletion(int status){
  91:                 if(status==STATUS_COMMITTED){
  92:                     com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count("APPLIED".equals(state)?com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_APPLIED:com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_REJECTED);
  93:                     if("APPLIED".equals(state))com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.protection(symbol,observed);
  94:                     log.info("[FIX-153][PRICE_OUTCOME_COMMITTED] event={}, symbol={}, observedUtc={}, observedKsa={}, outcome={}, reason={}",id,symbol,observed,observed.atOffset(java.time.ZoneOffset.ofHours(3)),state,reason);
  95:                 }else log.debug("[FIX-153][PRICE_OUTCOME_NOT_COMMITTED] event={}, symbol={}, proposedOutcome={}, transactionCompletion={}; durable outcome must be read",id,symbol,state,status);
  96:             }
  97:         });
  98:     }
  99:     /** Startup and periodic conditional resolution: no replay and no symbol-entry fence.
 100:      * The conditional update waits behind an in-flight effect TX and cannot override APPLIED.
 101:      * Runtime absence alone is insufficient; candidates must also exceed a configured bound. */
 102:     @org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled(initialDelayString="${local-candle.resolver-initial-delay-ms:5000}",fixedDelayString="${local-candle.resolver-delay-ms:5000}")
 103:     public void resolvePending(){
 104:         if(!"OFF".equals(mode))return;
 105:         try {
 106:             // FIX-153: housekeeping uses its own statement timeout, without mutating the shared template.
 107:             var bounded=new JdbcTemplate(java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(jdbcTemplate.getDataSource()));bounded.setQueryTimeout(2);

package com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;

/** FIX-124: commit market input before locking a position. Execute protection
 * before publishing the closed-candle event, preserving that ordering. No outer
 * transaction may retain candle locks while a protection transaction runs.
 */
@Service
public class KlineTransactionCoordinator {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KlineTransactionCoordinator.class);
    private static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2;
    private KlineTiming timing = KlineTiming.loggingOnly();
    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
    public void setTiming(KlineTiming timing) { this.timing = timing; }
    private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
    private final Fix124ProtectionStore diagnostics;

    public KlineTransactionCoordinator(PlatformTransactionManager manager, Fix124ProtectionStore diagnostics) {
        transaction = new TransactionTemplate(manager);
        transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
        // FIX-153: current committed ordering after consistency locks; bound JDBC transaction work.
        transaction.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);
        transaction.setTimeout(30);
        this.diagnostics = diagnostics;
    }

    public void process(String symbol, String interval, Instant candleOpenTime, Instant observedAt,
                        BigDecimal price, Runnable persistInput, Runnable protect,
                        Runnable observe, Runnable publishClosed) {
        var context = timing.context(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt, null);
        // Candle and exact canonical price observation commit together. A failed
        // input write must not produce an unrecorded protection decision.
        try {
            timing.measure(context,"INPUT_TRANSACTION",false,()->transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx->persistInput.run()));
            com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.INPUT_COMMITTED);
        }catch(RuntimeException failure){
            com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.INPUT_FAILED_OR_UNCONFIRMED);throw failure;
        }
        // FIX-131: executeWithoutResult returned successfully: this is input COMMIT, not callback completion.
        try { com.crypto.client.binance.websocket.KlineReceipt.inputCommitted(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt); }
        catch (RuntimeException diagnosticFailure) { log.warn("[FIX-131][RECEIPT_DIAGNOSTIC_FAILED] symbol={}", symbol, diagnosticFailure); }
        if (protect != null) {
            int attempts = 0;
            RuntimeException failure = null;
            do {
                attempts++;
                try {
                    timing.measure(context, "PROTECTION_TRANSACTION", false, () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> protect.run()));
                    failure = null;
                    break;
                } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
                    failure = ex;
                    // FIX-153: completion returned/failed; a commit exception alone does not prove rollback.
                    // Never retry a late wallet/commit error or an unknown outcome.
                    if (!(ex instanceof InitialPositionLockDeadlock) || attempts == MAX_ATTEMPTS) break;
                    log.warn("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][INITIAL_LOCK_RETRY] symbol={}, candleOpenTime={}, observedAt={}, attempt={}",
                            symbol, candleOpenTime, observedAt, attempts);
                }
            } while (attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS);
            if (failure != null || attempts > 1) {
                String outcome = failure == null ? "RECOVERED" : "FAILED";
                if (failure == null) {
                    log.info("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][RECOVERED] symbol={}, observedAt={}, attempts={}", symbol, observedAt, attempts);
                } else {
                    com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_FAILED_OR_UNCONFIRMED);
                    log.error("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][FAILED] symbol={}, observedAt={}, attempts={}; input committed; protection completion failed or unconfirmed, consult durable price evidence",
                            symbol, observedAt, attempts, failure);
                }
                diagnostics.record(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt, price, attempts, outcome, failure);
            }
        }
        if (observe != null) {
            try {
                timing.measure(context, "OBSERVER_TRANSACTION", false, () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> observe.run()));
            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
                log.warn("[FIX-124][OBSERVER_FAILED] symbol={}; input committed; protection outcome remains in durable price evidence", symbol, ex);
            }
        }
        // AFTER_COMMIT listener still receives an actual committed transaction;
        // publishing outside a transaction would silently drop the analysis event.
        if (publishClosed != null) timing.measure(context, "CLOSE_DISPATCH_TRANSACTION", false,
                () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> publishClosed.run()));
    }
}

package com.crypto.execution.service;

import com.crypto.market.service.MarketPriceEventService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * FIX-056 fresh execution-price authority.
 *
 * <p>TradeSignal.latestPrice is immutable decision-time evidence and must never be
 * treated as an execution fill. Production resolves the newest canonical Binance 1m
 * live-price event recorded by FIX-052. Administration Replay resolves the newest
 * replay price event already consumed by ExecutionReplayScope. This gives both paths
 * one price authority while preserving the original signal snapshot for audit.</p>
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ExecutionPriceAuthorityService {
    private static final Duration MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE = Duration.ofSeconds(15);

    private final MarketPriceEventService marketPriceEventService;
    private final ExecutionReplayScope replayScope;

    public Optional<ExecutionPrice> resolve(String symbol, Instant referenceTime) {
        // FIX-109 / Replay parity: wall-clock fallback is forbidden. Every caller must
        // supply the evaluation clock explicitly so historical Replay can never silently
        // compare an old market event with the machine clock used by Production today.
        Instant reference = Objects.requireNonNull(referenceTime,
                "Execution price reference time is required");

        if (replayScope.active()) {
            return replayScope.latestPrice()
                    .filter(p -> symbol != null && symbol.equalsIgnoreCase(p.symbol()))
                    .filter(p -> !p.observedAt().isAfter(reference))
                    .filter(p -> !Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).isNegative())
                    .filter(p -> Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).compareTo(MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE) <= 0)
                    .map(p -> new ExecutionPrice(p.price(), p.observedAt(), "REPLAY_MARKET_PRICE_EVENT"));
        }

        return marketPriceEventService.findLatestAtOrBefore(symbol, reference)
                .filter(p -> Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).compareTo(MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE) <= 0)
                .map(p -> new ExecutionPrice(p.price(), p.observedAt(), p.source()));
    }

    public record ExecutionPrice(BigDecimal price, Instant observedAt, String source) {}
}

package com.crypto.position.service;

import com.crypto.domain.SignalDecision;
import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * Shared production/replay exit authority for an already-open long position.
 *
 * The policy deliberately separates short-timeframe noise from a genuine
 * higher-timeframe breakdown:
 *  - a 1m pullback alone never closes the position;
 *  - the existing 1m SELL + bearish 5m confirmation remains valid;
 *  - a fresh 1h SELL may close a position when 5m is no longer supportive;
 *  - a Profit Lock breach is tolerated while 5m/1h still support the bullish thesis.
 */
@Component
public class PositionExitPolicy {

    public Evaluation evaluateNormalExit(TradeSignal current, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour) {
        SignalDecision currentDecision = decision(current);
        SignalDecision fiveDecision = decision(fiveMinute);
        SignalDecision oneDecision = decision(oneHour);

        boolean oneHourBreakdown = bearish(oneDecision)
                && fiveMinute != null
                && !supportive(fiveDecision);
        if (oneHourBreakdown) {
            return Evaluation.exit("HTF_SELL_CONFIRMED",
                    "1h turned " + label(oneDecision)
                            + " while 5m is no longer supportive (" + label(fiveDecision)
                            + "). The higher-timeframe bullish thesis is broken; close the managed position.");
        }

        boolean lowerFrameConfirmed = current != null
                && "1m".equals(current.getInterval())
                && bearish(currentDecision)
                && fiveMinute != null
                && bearish(fiveDecision)
                && (oneHour == null || !bullish(oneDecision));
        if (lowerFrameConfirmed) {
            return Evaluation.exit("SELL_CONFIRMED",
                    "1m " + label(currentDecision) + " is confirmed by bearish 5m while 1h is not bullish.");
        }

        return Evaluation.hold("No confirmed multi-timeframe exit."
                + " current=" + label(currentDecision)
                + ", 5m=" + label(fiveDecision)
                + ", 1h=" + label(oneDecision) + ".");
    }

    public Evaluation evaluateProfitLockBreach(TradeSignal current, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour) {
        SignalDecision currentDecision = decision(current);
        SignalDecision fiveDecision = decision(fiveMinute);
        SignalDecision oneDecision = decision(oneHour);

        // Strong HTF support: tolerate a sharp 1m pullback instead of throwing away the trend.
        if (bullish(oneDecision) && fiveMinute != null && supportive(fiveDecision)) {
            return Evaluation.hold("PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD",
                    "Profit Lock was breached, but higher-timeframe continuation remains healthy:"
                            + " 1h=" + label(oneDecision) + ", 5m=" + label(fiveDecision)
                            + ", current=" + label(currentDecision)
                            + ". Treat the breach as a protected pullback, not an immediate SELL.");
        }

        // Cooling but still-supported trend: WATCH/WATCH is allowed to breathe while the current frame is not bearish.
        if (oneDecision == SignalDecision.WATCH
                && fiveMinute != null && supportive(fiveDecision)
                && !bearish(currentDecision)) {
            return Evaluation.hold("PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD",
                    "Profit Lock was breached during a supported consolidation:"
                            + " 1h=WATCH, 5m=" + label(fiveDecision)
                            + ", current=" + label(currentDecision)
                            + ". Keep the winner protected while waiting for higher-timeframe confirmation.");
        }

        if (bearish(oneDecision)) {
            return Evaluation.exit("PROFIT_LOCK_HTF_EXIT",
                    "Profit Lock was breached and 1h is " + label(oneDecision)
                            + "; higher-timeframe support has failed.");
        }

        if (bearish(currentDecision) && bearish(fiveDecision)) {
            return Evaluation.exit("PROFIT_LOCK_BEARISH_CONFIRMATION",
                    "Profit Lock was breached with bearish 1m and 5m confirmation.");
        }

        return Evaluation.exit("PROFIT_LOCK_EXIT",
                "Profit Lock was breached without enough higher-timeframe bullish support to justify a protected hold:"
                        + " current=" + label(currentDecision)
                        + ", 5m=" + label(fiveDecision)
                        + ", 1h=" + label(oneDecision) + ".");
    }

    private SignalDecision decision(TradeSignal signal) {
        return signal == null ? null : signal.getDecision();
    }

    private boolean supportive(SignalDecision decision) {
        return decision == SignalDecision.BUY
                || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY
                || decision == SignalDecision.WATCH;
    }

    private boolean bullish(SignalDecision decision) {
        return decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY;
    }

    private boolean bearish(SignalDecision decision) {
        return decision == SignalDecision.SELL || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL;
    }

    private String label(SignalDecision decision) {
        return decision == null ? "MISSING" : decision.name();
    }

    public record Evaluation(boolean exit, String code, String explanation) {
        public static Evaluation exit(String code, String explanation) {
            return new Evaluation(true, code, explanation);
        }

        public static Evaluation hold(String explanation) {
            return new Evaluation(false, "HOLD", explanation);
        }

        public static Evaluation hold(String code, String explanation) {
            return new Evaluation(false, code, explanation);
        }
    }
}

package com.crypto.position.service;

import com.crypto.domain.SignalDecision;
import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * Shared production/replay policy for deciding whether a reached profit target should be extended.
 *
 * IMPORTANT: this class manages an ALREADY-OPEN winner only. It does not loosen BUY generation,
 * entry validation, stop loss, or bearish timeframe vetoes.
 */
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PositionContinuationPolicy {
    /** Minor/moderate immutable-thesis deterioration is tolerated at a TP checkpoint. */
    static final int MAX_CONTINUATION_TREND_PRESSURE = 2;
    /** Momentum must remain essentially intact for the thesis-preservation continuation path. */
    static final int MAX_CONTINUATION_MOMENTUM_PRESSURE = 1;

    private final PositionThesisPressurePolicy thesisPressurePolicy;

    /**
     * Backward-compatible evaluator used by older unit fixtures. Production/replay should pass
     * the full immutable entry thesis through the overload below.
     */
    public Evaluation evaluate(TradeSignal current, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour,
                               Integer entryTrend, Integer entryMomentum, Integer entryVolume) {
        return evaluate(current, fiveMinute, oneHour,
                entryTrend, null, entryMomentum, entryVolume, null, null);
    }

    public Evaluation evaluate(TradeSignal current, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour,
                               Integer entryTrend, Integer entryStructure,
                               Integer entryMomentum, Integer entryVolume,
                               Integer entryConfidence, Integer entryTotal) {
        if (current == null) return new Evaluation(false, "Continuation FAIL Aú no fresh signal context.");
        if (bearish(current.getDecision()) || (fiveMinute != null && bearish(fiveMinute.getDecision()))
                || (oneHour != null && bearish(oneHour.getDecision()))) {
            return new Evaluation(false, "Continuation FAIL Aú bearish timeframe detected; normal exit remains active.");
        }

        boolean currentSupport = supportive(current.getDecision());
        boolean fiveSupport = fiveMinute != null && supportive(fiveMinute.getDecision());
        boolean fiveNonBearish = fiveMinute != null && !bearish(fiveMinute.getDecision());
        boolean oneSafe = oneHour == null || !bearish(oneHour.getDecision());
        boolean oneBullish = oneHour != null && bullish(oneHour.getDecision());

        int trendFloor = Math.max(12, nvl(entryTrend) - 3);
        int momentumFloor = Math.max(7, nvl(entryMomentum) - 4);
        int volumeSoftFloor = Math.max(2, nvl(entryVolume) - 8);

        boolean trendHealthy = current.getTrendScore() >= trendFloor;
        boolean momentumHealthy = current.getMomentumScore() >= momentumFloor;
        boolean volumeSupportive = current.getVolumeScore() >= volumeSoftFloor;

        // Standard continuation: structure is still supportive. Volume is deliberately a soft
        // confirmation because breakout volume commonly cools while a healthy trend continues.
        boolean standard = currentSupport && fiveSupport && oneSafe
                && trendHealthy && momentumHealthy
                && (volumeSupportive || oneBullish);

        // Protected HTF continuation: a live 1h BUY may carry a winner through a neutral/cooling
        // 5m phase. It never overrides bearish context and still requires healthy 1m trend/momentum.
        boolean htfProtected = currentSupport && oneBullish && fiveNonBearish
                && trendHealthy && momentumHealthy;

        // Healthy consolidation: low volume is deliberately NOT a hard veto for an already
        // profitable position. If 1m is still WATCH/BUY, the higher timeframes are non-bearish,
        // and trend/momentum remain healthy, cooling volume alone must not force a TP exit.
        boolean healthyConsolidation = currentSupport && fiveNonBearish && oneSafe
                && trendHealthy && momentumHealthy;

        // HTF-supported consolidation: a strong 1h BUY may carry a winner through one neutral
        // 1m candle when 5m remains non-bearish. This is position-management-only; supportive()
        // is intentionally unchanged so entry rules are not loosened.
        boolean currentNonBearish = !bearish(current.getDecision());
        boolean htfSupportedConsolidation = currentNonBearish && !currentSupport
                && oneBullish && fiveNonBearish && trendHealthy && momentumHealthy;

        PositionThesisPressurePolicy.ThesisPressure thesis = thesisPressurePolicy.evaluate(
                entryTrend, entryStructure, entryMomentum, entryVolume,
                entryConfidence, entryTotal, current);

        // FIX-011 / SOLUSDT 2026-08-19:
        // At TP, SOL had 1m WATCH, 5m NEUTRAL, 1h WATCH and momentum improved 13->15.
        // The old binary trend floor rejected continuation solely because trend fell 21->16
        // (16 < 18), even though PositionManagementService scored the SAME immutable thesis as
        // trend pressure 2/8, momentum pressure 0/5 and HOLD. This narrow path aligns both
        // components: minor thesis cooling may extend a winner, but any bearish timeframe still
        // vetoes above and genuine trend/momentum breakdown still fails these pressure limits.
        boolean thesisIntactConsolidation = currentSupport && fiveNonBearish && oneSafe
                && thesis.trendPressure() <= MAX_CONTINUATION_TREND_PRESSURE
                && thesis.momentumPressure() <= MAX_CONTINUATION_MOMENTUM_PRESSURE;

        boolean extend = standard || htfProtected || healthyConsolidation
                || htfSupportedConsolidation || thesisIntactConsolidation;
        String path = htfProtected ? "HTF_TREND"
                : (standard ? "STANDARD"
                : (htfSupportedConsolidation ? "HTF_SUPPORTED_CONSOLIDATION"
                : (healthyConsolidation ? "HEALTHY_CONSOLIDATION"
                : (thesisIntactConsolidation ? "THESIS_INTACT_CONSOLIDATION" : "NONE"))));
        String checks = "current=" + decision(current)
                + ", 5m=" + decision(fiveMinute)
                + ", 1h=" + decision(oneHour)
                + ", trend=" + current.getTrendScore() + "/" + trendFloor
                + ", momentum=" + current.getMomentumScore() + "/" + momentumFloor
                + ", volume=" + current.getVolumeScore() + "/soft " + volumeSoftFloor
                + ", thesisPressure=" + thesis.trendPressure() + "/8 trend, "
                + thesis.momentumPressure() + "/5 momentum";

        return new Evaluation(extend, extend
                ? "Continuation PASS (" + path + "): " + checks
                    + ". Volume is advisory during a healthy winner; cooling volume alone does not end the trend."
                : "Continuation FAIL: " + checks
                    + ". Trend/momentum or higher-timeframe structure no longer supports extending the target; allow normal protection/exit logic.");
    }

    private int nvl(Integer v) { return v == null ? 0 : v; }
    private String decision(TradeSignal s) { return s == null || s.getDecision() == null ? "MISSING" : s.getDecision().name(); }
    private boolean supportive(SignalDecision d) { return d == SignalDecision.BUY || d == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY || d == SignalDecision.WATCH; }
    private boolean bullish(SignalDecision d) { return d == SignalDecision.BUY || d == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY; }
    private boolean bearish(SignalDecision d) { return d == SignalDecision.SELL || d == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL; }
    public record Evaluation(boolean extendTarget, String explanation) {}
}

  `BinanceKlineService` → input transaction (candle + canonical 1m `market_price_event` as `PENDING`) → protection transaction → observer transaction → closed-candle dispatch. The observed time is Binance message event time `E`, represented as a UTC `Instant`. [BinanceKlineService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/BinanceKlineService.java:93), [KlineTransactionCoordinator.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/transaction/KlineTransactionCoordinator.java:31)

- **[PROJECT EVIDENCE]** For a canonical 1m observation, protection rejects invalid, future, stale, and out-of-order prices as `NON_CANONICAL`; otherwise it completes the price receipt as `APPLIED` in the protection-effects transaction. An aged unresolved direct receipt can become `PROTECTION_NOT_APPLIED`. Thus candle OHLC must not be substituted for missing accepted price-event evidence. [LivePositionProtectionService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/position/service/LivePositionProtectionService.java:54), [MarketPriceEventService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/market/service/MarketPriceEventService.java:40)

- **[PROJECT EVIDENCE]** A new `paper_position` is created only after a signal is claimed, locked, freshness-checked, approved by execution intelligence, revalidated against a recent canonical execution price, and accepted by paper-wallet BUY execution. The stored row records entry signal, execution price, current stop/target, quantity, and `opened_at`.
